article.title: Moxie Marlinspike has a privacy-conscious alternative to ChatGPT

key_talking_points: Moxie Marlinspike (Signal founder) entered the AI space with a focus on privacy.
Addresses the 'data collection fatigue' many feel with OpenAI/Meta.
The potential for ads in ChatGPT-like interfaces as a motivator for alternatives.
content_angles: Why your ChatGPT conversations aren't private and why it matters.
Vietnamese developers: Is it time to switch to privacy-first LLMs for sensitive projects?
viral_analysis.viral_potential_reasoning: High relevance in the VN tech community which values decentralized and privacy-focused tools (Signal, Telegram). The name 'Moxie Marlinspike' carries significant weight in cybersecurity circles.
